line: Ask any AI chatbot if it's connected to the internet. It can't actually tell you what is true.
Here's proof: this one's network connection is completely cut. Not airplane mode — actually disconnected, at the system level.
Ask it anyway, and it still guesses. "I'm a cloud-based model. I can't work without a connection."
It's wrong. It's responding right now, from this laptop, with no connection at all.
The tool doing this is called Ollama — free, open source, built to run real models like Llama with zero internet.
One command downloads the model, once. After that, the network is optional.
It's not a toy demo. Real code, real math, a real conversation — same model, zero internet.
The exact setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
